blurb: Pop Air is an inflatable art exhibition featuring monumental installations, vibrant colors, and interactive artworks by internationally renowned artists. Visitors explore, interact, and experience art through play, curiosity, and wonder. The exhibition is designed for all ages and is located at Mana Wynwood Convention Center in Miami.
